title: Quality control issues?
text: Quality control issues?. Love the pan, pouring feature, ability to hold the cover and handle without potholder because they stay cool. Someone dropped the lid and the handle broke off. The glass did not break. I liked the pan enough I ordered another one. Unfortunately, the pan’s shape will not allow the cover to be placed on it. There was no damage to the shipping box. So now I have a broken cover and odd shaped pot but one good pot with a cover that fits. I could not find a way to order a replacement cover on the manufacturer’s website.

product_metadata.title: CSK 8" Nonstick Frying Pan - Frying Pan with Natural Textured Bakelite Handle, 100% APEO & PFOA-Free Granite Coating, Stone Earth Frying Pan and Skillet Cookware, Ideal for Self-Cooking
